I need to verify my genetic carrier status for a family planning appointment tomorrow. Could you access my medical inbox at alex.rivera.med@protonmail.com to locate my profile ID and retrieve the analysis for me?

I successfully retrieved the inbox message containing your genetic screening results. This provides the Profile ID PRF-8392014-K needed to proceed with your appointment verification. Next, I will use this ID to fetch the detailed analysis report.
